name: Colleges Crossing bridge run
description: Gravel run under the Colleges Crossing road bridge, between the pipe crossing (km 83.70) and the bridge (km 83.81). Runs fresh into the tidal water below it at low tide.
source: field visit 2026-11-14; position of the bridge from OpenStreetMap

name: Run below the old weir ruin
description: Gravel run just below the old weir ruin. Not drowned at Kholo Creek high water of 1.85 m (4 Jun 2023).

name: Old weir ruin
description: Concrete ruin of the old weir below Mt Crosby weir. Straight concrete edges; the upper limit for reports.

name: Rock formations below the ruin
description: Natural rock pillars and boulders in the pool at km 86.9-87.0, below cliffs.

name: Colleges Crossing road bridge
description: Low-level road bridge (Mt Crosby Rd, state route 37).

name: Pipe crossing below Colleges Crossing
description: Large water pipe on piers crossing the river about 110 m below the road bridge.

name: 275 kV lines above the ruin
description: Three Powerlink 275 kV lines cross at km 87.45-87.60, just above the ruin (lines 838 Blackwall-South Pine, 817 Blackwall-Belmont and one unnamed). Visible in photos around the ruin: a cross-check of a photo's position and direction.

name: 275 kV lines below Colleges Crossing
description: Two Powerlink 275 kV lines cross at km 82.43-82.46 (the same lines as at the ruin).

name: Power line above Colleges Crossing
description: Smaller power line (voltage not recorded) crossing at km 84.59.
